# bommel.xyz

> Personal site and blog of Eelco van Bommel: long-form articles on AI, technology, science, culture and society.

## Main pages

- [Blog](https://pages.bommel.xyz/blog/): all posts, newest first
- [About](https://pages.bommel.xyz/about/): how this site is built
- [Sitemap](https://pages.bommel.xyz/sitemap.xml): every URL with a lastmod date

## Notes

- Posts are written in English and each post ends with a Sources list of linked pages.
- Categories: AI, Culture, Economics, Lifestyle, Nature, Science, Society, Software Development, Sport, Technology, Travel, YouTube.
